PluginData.Author: Matelemons
PluginData.Tooltip: HDR10 output: 10-bit PQ swapchain and a PQ transfer function patched into the post-process chain
PluginData.Description: Adds HDR10 output to Space Engineers 2. This is done by replacing the SDR tonemap code with an HDR tonemap, remapping color values Rec.709 -> Rec.2020 and applying ST.2084 PQ. Code is patched to change the swapchain format to 10-bit. Shaders are patched in-memory. Requires an HDR display with HDR enabled in Windows. Report issues at https://github.com/Matusson/SE2_HDR/issues
